senses.gloss:
† अङ्घ् अङ्घ्, i. 1. Ātm.
 1. To go.
 2. To begin moving.
 3. To begin.
 4. To hasten.
 5. To blame.
 6. To despise.

अङ्घ्रि अङ्घ्रि (akin to जङ्घा from जङ्घन्, the frequent. of हन्; the initial consonant is lost, as e. g. in इनक्ष् for निनस्क्ष् and others, and न् is changed to र्, as in पीवर् + ई fem. of पीवन्), m.
 1. A foot.
 2. The root of a tree.
 --Comp.
